usage: lab.py [-h] {doctor,setup,verify,smoke,prepare,ingest,rig,review} ...

Local rigging laboratory: diagnostics, isolated setup and a recorded UniRig
smoke test.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,setup,verify,smoke,prepare,ingest,rig,review}
    doctor              Record host, GPU, tool and storage diagnostics
    setup               Install pinned UniRig packages and cache its models
    verify              Execute real CUDA kernels and Blender imports
    smoke               Run the official giraffe installation test
    prepare             Prepare rest-pose copies and a normalized original rig
                        control
    ingest              Validate and copy reviewed creation evidence;
                        explicitly normalize an isolated candidate
    rig                 Run generated skeleton and skinning on a prepared
                        corpus asset
    review              Bake equivalent diagnostic stills and build the local
                        gallery inventory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
